combo1.title: Oni of Shyma, one card: Firelord of Yama, Goblin's Crazy Beast and a Set Escape
combo1.description: Going first with Unchained Oni of Shyma and nothing else. This is the TCG version of the one-card route にだいめ (nidaime) published on the Yuyu-tei blog on 9 June 2026. That OCG route ends on D/D/D Wave High King Caesar, which is Forbidden in the TCG, so here the two Level 6 Fiends make Goblin's Crazy Beast instead. Oni of Shyma's summon effect locks you into Fiend monsters for the rest of the turn, and every monster in the line is a Fiend. Starting hand: Unchained Oni of Shyma. Deck needs: Unchained Twins - Rakea, Unchained Twins - Aruha, Unchained Twins - Sarama, Unchained Soul of Shyama, Unchained Soul of Sharvara, Unchained Oni of Shara, Escape of the Unchained. Extra Deck: Unchained Soul Lord of Yama, Unchained Soul of Abominable Rage, Unchained Soul of Rage, Goblin's Crazy Beast, Unchained Firelord of Yama. End board: Unchained Firelord of Yama, Goblin's Crazy Beast with Soul of Shyama and Sharvara attached, and a Set Escape of the Unchained, with Abominable Rage in the GY. The simulator stops before the End Phase. In your End Phase, Firelord of Yama Special Summons up to 2 Fiends that were destroyed this turn and are still in your GY: take Unchained Soul of Rage and Unchained Twins - Rakea. On your opponent's turn, Soul of Rage can turn one of their Special Summoned monsters into Link material in their Main Phase. Rakea's Quick Effect destroys one of your own cards to start another float. Abominable Rage can banish itself from the GY to destroy a monster that activates its effect on the field, because you control Firelord, a Link-4 "Unchained" Link Monster. Goblin's Crazy Beast attaches a Spell or Trap on the field; if it detaches Sharvara for that, Sharvara Sets another "Unchained" Spell/Trap from your Deck. Firelord destroys another face-up card instead of itself once per turn. Reincarnation of the Unchained starts the same line from a Spell: it adds Abomination's Prison, which adds Oni of Shyma.

steps.text: Normal Summon Unchained Oni of Shyma.
Activate effect: Unchained Oni of Shyma's on-summon effect, to Special Summon Unchained Twins - Rakea from your Deck.
Special Summon Unchained Twins - Rakea from your Deck.
Destroy Unchained Twins - Rakea. From now on this turn you are locked into Fiend monsters.
Activate effect: Unchained Twins - Rakea was destroyed by another card's effect, to Special Summon Unchained Soul of Shyama from your Deck.
Special Summon Unchained Soul of Shyama from your Deck.
Activate effect: Unchained Soul of Shyama on the field, targeting Unchained Oni of Shyma.
Destroy Unchained Oni of Shyma. There is no Spell or Trap to destroy afterwards.
Activate effect: Unchained Oni of Shyma was destroyed by another card's effect, to Special Summon Unchained Soul of Sharvara from your Deck.
Special Summon Unchained Soul of Sharvara from your Deck.
Unchained Soul of Shyama becomes Link material.
Unchained Soul of Sharvara becomes Link material.
Link Summon Unchained Soul Lord of Yama (2 Fiend monsters) to the left Extra Monster Zone.
Chain Link 1: Sharvara went to the GY, so its effect Sets Escape of the Unchained from your Deck.
Chain Link 2: Unchained Soul Lord of Yama's on-summon effect adds Unchained Twins - Aruha from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: Unchained Twins - Aruha in your hand, targeting your face-down Escape of the Unchained.
Destroy Escape of the Unchained.
Special Summon Unchained Twins - Aruha from your hand.
Escape of the Unchained was destroyed while Set: its effect Special Summons Unchained Oni of Shara from your Deck.
Unchained Oni of Shara becomes Link material.
Unchained Soul Lord of Yama becomes Link material. A Link-2 counts as 2 materials.
Link Summon Unchained Soul of Abominable Rage using Unchained Oni of Shara and Unchained Soul Lord of Yama, to the left Extra Monster Zone.
Activate effect: Unchained Soul of Shyama in your GY, targeting Unchained Twins - Aruha. Shyama returns to your leftmost Main Monster Zone, and goes to the bottom of the Deck if it leaves the field.
Destroy Unchained Twins - Aruha.
Chain Link 1: Unchained Twins - Aruha's effect Special Summons Unchained Twins - Sarama from your Deck, because Aruha was destroyed by another card's effect.

Chain Link 2: Unchained Oni of Shara's effect Special Summons it from your GY, because a card on the field was destroyed by a card effect while it was there. It goes to the bottom of the Deck if it leaves the field.
Chain Link 3: Unchained Soul Lord of Yama's effect, because a card you control was destroyed: banish it from your GY as the cost.
Unchained Soul Lord of Yama's effect Special Summons Unchained Soul of Sharvara from your GY. Don't destroy a card with it.
Unchained Soul of Sharvara becomes Link material.
Unchained Oni of Shara becomes Link material. It goes to the bottom of your Deck.
Link Summon Unchained Soul of Rage using Unchained Soul of Sharvara and Unchained Oni of Shara. Shara's zone is the one Abominable Rage points to.
Activate effect: Unchained Twins - Sarama, targeting Escape of the Unchained in your GY.
Set Escape of the Unchained from your GY.
Destroy Unchained Soul of Rage.
Activate effect: Unchained Soul of Rage was destroyed, targeting Unchained Soul of Sharvara in your GY.
Add Unchained Soul of Sharvara from your GY to your hand.

Activate effect: Unchained Soul of Sharvara in your hand (Quick Effect), targeting Unchained Twins - Sarama. Sharvara comes to the field from your hand; while it stays face-up you can only Special Summon Fiend monsters.
Destroy Unchained Twins - Sarama.
Activate effect: Unchained Twins - Sarama was destroyed by Sharvara's effect, to Special Summon Unchained Oni of Shara from your Deck.
Special Summon Unchained Oni of Shara from your Deck.
Xyz Summon Goblin's Crazy Beast using Unchained Soul of Shyama and Unchained Soul of Sharvara (2 Level 6 monsters).
Unchained Soul of Shyama becomes Xyz material.
Unchained Soul of Sharvara becomes Xyz material.
Unchained Soul of Abominable Rage becomes Link material. A Link-3 counts as 3 materials.
Unchained Oni of Shara becomes Link material.
Link Summon Unchained Firelord of Yama using Unchained Soul of Abominable Rage and Unchained Oni of Shara, to the left Extra Monster Zone. Abominable Rage is the "Unchained Soul" monster it needs.

combo2.title: Going second: Kamra and Escape of the Unchained clear the field
combo2.description: Going second into a field of monsters, with Unchained Zealot - Kamra and Escape of the Unchained. Deck needs: Unchained Twins - Rakea, Abominable Unchained Soul. Set Escape, then Kamra destroys it to Special Summon itself. A Trap was among the destroyed cards, so Kamra's last bonus destroys 1 other card on the field: one of your opponent's monsters. Escape was destroyed while Set, so it Special Summons Rakea from your Deck, and Rakea's Quick Effect destroys Kamra. Kamra was destroyed by a card effect, so it destroys every monster on the field, Rakea included. Rakea was destroyed by another card's effect, so it Special Summons Abominable Unchained Soul (3000 ATK) from your Deck, and your Normal Summon is still unused. If your opponent has a Set Spell or Trap left, Abominable Unchained Soul's summon effect can discard 1 card to destroy it; the simulator's opponent has none. Rakea's effect locks you into Fiend monsters for the rest of the turn. Kamra's hand effect is not a Quick Effect, so this only works in your own Main Phase, and Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring can be chained to it.

cards.name: Any second monster your opponent controls

steps.text: Set Escape of the Unchained from your hand.
Activate effect: Unchained Zealot - Kamra in your hand, targeting your face-down Escape of the Unchained.
Destroy Escape of the Unchained.
Special Summon Unchained Zealot - Kamra from your hand.
Destroy your opponent's monster. A Trap was among the destroyed cards, so Kamra's last bonus destroys 1 other card on the field.
Activate effect: Escape of the Unchained was destroyed while face-down, to Special Summon Unchained Twins - Rakea from your Deck.
Special Summon Unchained Twins - Rakea from your Deck.
Activate effect: Unchained Twins - Rakea (Quick Effect), targeting Unchained Zealot - Kamra. For the rest of this turn you can only Special Summon Fiend monsters.
Destroy Unchained Zealot - Kamra.
Activate effect: Unchained Zealot - Kamra was destroyed by Rakea's effect, to destroy all monsters on the field.
Destroy Unchained Twins - Rakea.
Destroy your opponent's other monster.
Activate effect: Unchained Twins - Rakea was destroyed by Kamra's effect, to Special Summon Abominable Unchained Soul from your Deck.
Special Summon Abominable Unchained Soul from your Deck. Don't use its effect: your opponent has no card left for it to destroy.
